status: Implemented; local package/native workspace/ASAN acceptance passed; hosted native chooser/Save As tests pending

originalBehavior.unsaved: MPDocument.m:1068 chooses htmlDefaultDirectoryUrl only without fileURL. Original default is Home and Settings has an editable folder path control.
originalBehavior.saved: Saved document URL supersedes that fallback.
originalBehavior.storage: PAPreferences 0.5 uses UserDefaults URLForKey/setURL. The migrated URL is decoded through that same Foundation accessor.

implementation: Native searchable Privacy & Security row: Choose Folder, Clear and recoverable Retry/status. Catalog now has 49 unique entries. Native folder chooser cancel preserves choice.
Legacy htmlDefaultDirectoryUrl is a suggested folder only; explicit folder selection creates a read-only security-scoped bookmark. No implicit Home fallback or widened resource reader.

Bookmark restore/create/validation execute away from the main actor. Restore avoids automatic UI/volume mounting, renews stale data, and retains damaged/unavailable saved choices for explicit recovery.
A balanced immutable scope object is retained by the current preview, individual async resource requests and frozen export snapshots. Clearing Settings cannot revoke an in-flight export read.
The same directory resolution routes preview, HTML, PDF and print. Saved documents select their own containing directory. No document source/revision/undo mutation for folder changes.

Each preview reload has a fresh mdasset origin, validated against the active request namespace before mapping into the existing bounded/symlink-safe local reader. This prevents stale same-name images across root changes.
Model-owned undo/redo may update the document before SwiftUI synchronizes NSTextView. The editor undo observer now rejects its older buffer when the synchronized source revision is stale.

If a remembered folder cannot restore, exports needing relative Markdown images fail with an explicit folder-recovery message. Plain text, remote images and copied fragments do not require that folder. Frozen snapshots preserve unavailable/available state.
